headline: Danantara Investment Projects Profit of Rp5T–Rp6T in 2027
summary: PT Danantara Investment Management projects 2027 net profit of Rp5 trillion to Rp6 trillion. The projection was reported by CNBC Indonesia.
why: Danantara is an Indonesian state-owned investment management company that holds and manages stakes in state enterprises. Its earnings outlook indicates how it may perform as a state investor.
original_headline: Danantara Investment Proyeksi Laba Rp5T-Rp6 T Pada 2027
